List/numbering structure not preserved in multiple places: Article 15(4), Article 17(3), Article 20(2), Article 21(1)-(2), Article 23(1), Article 31(2), and Article 32 have merged markers/content; Article 26 and Article 30 have (2) embedded in the same line as (1) rather than as a separate numbered item.
